_about: A made-up food truck for the kit test (2026-11-10). No photos: the owner's are on Instagram. It moves around, so the page needs this week's stops, which the kit has no section for: the one custom section the hybrid writes.
owner_brief: ok so me and my husband started a food truck 3 yrs ago, we do bbq, and we move around so people always ask where we are. i want something that shows where we'll be this week but i also want it to look really nice like a real restaurant, not cheap. also we do catering which is where the money is

offerings.name: Backyard Feed
offerings.description: Brisket, pulled pork, two sides and rolls for 25 to 60 people. Priced per guest. Book a call and we'll plan it.

offerings.name: Office Lunch
offerings.description: Sandwich boxes or a hot line for 15 to 40. Priced per guest, delivered hot.

offerings.name: The Big Day
offerings.description: Weddings and reunions: the smoker comes with us and we carve on site. Three sides and dessert. Priced per guest, 50 guests and up.

testimonials.name: Keisha M.
testimonials.quote: We hired them for my dad's 70th. Ninety people, everybody went back for seconds, and the brisket was gone before the cake came out.

the_ask.words: i want something that shows where we'll be this week but i also want it to look really nice like a real restaurant, not cheap. also we do catering which is where the money is

team.name: Dana Ruiz
team.role: Pitmaster. Runs the smoker, starts the brisket the night before.

team.name: Marco Ruiz
team.role: Runs the window and the catering.
